body:
## What is hand block printing?

In Jaipur, artisans carve designs into wooden blocks, dip them in colour and press them onto fabric by hand – one motif at a time. Every piece carries tiny variations that machines cannot copy. That is the signature of real handmade craft.

## Hand block print vs screen print

| | Hand block print | Screen / digital print |
|---|---|---|
| Made by | Artisans, by hand | Machines |
| Look | Soft, slightly irregular | Perfectly uniform |
| Feel | Gets softer with every wash | Can feel flat |
| Uniqueness | No two pieces alike | Identical copies |

## Our block print styles

- Cotton kurta sets with matching pants and Kota Doria dupattas
- Short tunic tops to wear with jeans
- Maxi dresses and co-ord sets

## Shipping, fit and returns

- **Free worldwide shipping** to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia, with tracking
- Ready sizes ship in 2–4 working days; made-to-measure pieces take 5–7 working days, then 5–10 business days for delivery
- **Free custom fit** – send your bust, waist, hip and height and we stitch it for you
- We send you photos of your piece before it ships
- Customs duties, if any, are charged by your country on delivery

Want to see the printing process? [WhatsApp us](https://wa.me/917073350886) – we share photos of your piece being made.

faq.q: Will the block print colours fade?
faq.a: Wash in cold water separately for the first few washes and dry in shade. Handmade prints soften beautifully over time while keeping their colour.

faq.q: Why are there small irregularities in the print?
faq.a: Each motif is stamped by hand, so small variations in alignment and colour are a mark of genuine hand block printing, not a defect.
